transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I guess I came in because I haven’t really felt like myself. Most days I wake up with this heavy, kind of hollow feeling in my chest. I’m probably not explaining it right, but it’s like the old Ruben—the guy who could talk to anybody and enjoy his day—he just feels… gone.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, don’t interest you as much anymore?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but yes. I used to really look forward to bowling, messing around in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows… even going dancing. Now I mostly just sit there and come up with excuses not to go. It just feels like too much effort, like none of it is really worth doing. Does that make sense?
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um… I guess if I’m being honest, it’s been about eight months. I kept thinking it was just a rough patch and I’d shake it off, but it kind of started around when the new regional manager came in and began really getting on me… taking away accounts I’d handled for years. I don’t want to sound like I’m blaming everything on work, but that’s about when it started.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still and feel restless?

I’m not sure… I haven’t really paid attention to that, to be honest. I don’t think I’m pacing around or anything like that. Moving slowly… maybe, but I wouldn’t want to say for sure. I guess I just feel kind of weighed down, if that’s what you mean.
Do you find that you feel down or low most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yeah… I think so. I try not to dwell on it, and I know everybody has bad days, but most mornings I wake up with this heavy, kind of hollow feeling in my chest. Like… the old Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy the day, just isn’t really there. I don’t know if that’s the right way to put it.
Have you noticed a change in your energy levels or do you feel more tired than usual, even after getting enough rest?

I mean… I guess I feel tired, but I don’t know if it’s more than what most people my age feel, you know? I still try to get up and do what I’m supposed to do. Some days I feel kind of drained even if I’ve slept, but… I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?

I don’t think so… not in any big way. I mean, my eating’s probably not perfect, but I haven’t really noticed my clothes fitting different or anything like that. I still eat, maybe just not always with much thought behind it. I’m not sure if that answers what you mean.
Have you found yourself feeling like a failure or blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to go there, because it sounds kind of dramatic. But I do catch myself thinking I’m… useless now. Like all those years taking care of clients, providing for my family, being the guy people could count on—somehow none of it counts because I can’t even seem to handle this job anymore.  

I know that probably isn’t a fair way to look at it, but it’s where my head goes. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you found yourself thinking about death, or wishing you were dead, or even thinking about hurting yourself?

I… I don’t want you to think I’m trying to be alarming or anything. I haven’t really wanted to say it out loud.

But yeah, I’ve had thoughts like… maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me, because I don’t trust myself the way I used to. Is that… is that what you’re asking?

Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or irritable—like you didn’t need much sleep, were talking more than usual, or getting involved in a lot of activities, even risky ones?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had times where I was stressed or snappy, sure, but not like I felt on top of the world or didn’t need sleep or was doing a bunch of out-of-character things.

I’m pretty sure nothing like that has happened… at least not that I’d call unusual in that way. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
Have you had experiences like this before—times where you felt down, lost interest in things, or struggled to feel like yourself?

I’m not sure, honestly. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches like anybody, you know—stress with work, getting tired of the routine, that kind of thing. But I don’t know if I’d say it was like this before.

I guess… not in a way that stands out to me as the same thing. I’m sorry if that’s not a very clear answer.
Have you ever had two or more separate periods in your life where you felt down, lost interest in things, and struggled like you have been now?

I don’t think so… not two separate times like this. I’ve had low points, sure, but I wouldn’t want to overstate it.

Nothing really comes to mind that felt like this before. I guess I’m not completely sure what counts, but as far as I can tell, no. Is that okay?
